day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Someone needs it more. Stand up, no announcement, keep scrolling.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the walk that is faster than the bus
signs.message: Twelve minutes waiting or twelve minutes walking. Walk it.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Stay in the shower past reasonable. The day starts after.
